pdf.notes: ACM DL (https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3805652) returns HTTP 403 behind a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' JS challenge, even with full browser headers and a cookie jar. OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar both report the article as open access CC-BY (hybrid) but expose no direct PDF URL, and Unpaywall has no record. No arXiv preprint exists. Obtained the author-hosted copy from last author Jiarong Xing's homepage (https://jxing.me/, Rice University). The file is the published camera-ready: first page carries the ACM Reference Format 'Proc. ACM Meas. Anal. Comput. Syst. 10, 2, Article 54 (June 2026), 27 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3805652'. Verified %PDF- magic, 27 pages, 1158356 bytes. Authors: Bei Ouyang (Rice), Yifan Qiao (UC Berkeley), Jiarong Xing (Rice).

repo.evidence: Already cloned by the driver; verified git remote is https://github.com/xsyslab/UniCache.git. The URL 'github.com/xsyslab/UniCache' appears verbatim in the camera-ready PDF text, and xsyslab is the GitHub org of the last author's lab (Jiarong Xing, Rice). README describes the trace-driven CPU prefix-caching simulator built on vLLM with the LRU/LFU/FIFO/OPT/LeCAR/ARC/WA eviction policies described in the paper. 31 visible top-level entries, 38 MB on disk.
